_comment: Hard gates for the structure-prediction panel. No ranking. A design passes if every gate that has a value on that row succeeds; a missing value skips that gate (e.g. HydrAMP not scored, or catalytic_ok not yet computed). AMP classifier gates plus the sequence/developability floors from select_permeable.py.

macrel_amp.reason: Macrel did not classify as AMP

catalytic_ok.reason: does not contact the catalytic core

net_charge.reason: net charge at pH 7.4 below floor (-10, essentially off)
